exposure: Surgical treatment for abdominal wall endometriosis (AWE)
cohort: The study involved 18 patients who underwent surgical treatment for pathologically diagnosed abdominal wall endometriosis (AWE) at a single gynecological surgery center between January 2004 and December 2020.
finding: The study found a cumulative recurrence rate of abdominal wall endometriosis (AWE) of 23.8% at 24 months and 39.1% at 60 months after surgical treatment, with no statistically significant risk factors identified.
